title: 2026-27 Modified Mastering Basic Numbers and Calculations Milestone

rows.criterion: Reads and writes numbers up to 9999 using expanded form and understanding zero as a placeholder, identifying the value of each digit
Compares, sorts and orders numbers up to 9999, including the use of > and < symbols
Rounds whole numbers to 9999 to the nearest 10, 100 and 1000
Selects appropriate mental and written strategies to solve real life addition problems to 9999, including two-step problems
Selects appropriate mental and written strategies to solve real life subtraction problems to 9999, including two-step problems
Estimates and uses a calculator to check answers to addition and subtraction problems
